subject.title: Rebrand text-substitution filter on tool-call arguments silently misroutes file ops

question: Which text-transform boundary should OpenClaw guarantee for path-like tool inputs after rebrand/plugin replacements?
rationale: The current behavior is source-reproducibly unsafe for path-like tool values, but changing it affects the documented plugin textTransforms contract and the recently merged tool-argument restoration path.

options.title: Choose a path-safe boundary
options.body: Preserve display and masking transforms while skipping or otherwise protecting path-like OpenClaw-owned tool inputs from blind rewrite, then require focused tests and live dual-directory proof.

options.title: Keep full transform semantics
options.body: Accept that plugins may rewrite tool argument strings and instead add doctor/debug diagnostics for rebrand migration cases.

options.title: Defer to broader API design
options.body: Keep this issue open while designing separate plugin surfaces for display transforms, masking restores, and functional tool input mutation.

recommendation.title: Choose a path-safe boundary
recommendation.body: Preserve display and masking transforms while skipping or otherwise protecting path-like OpenClaw-owned tool inputs from blind rewrite, then require focused tests and live dual-directory proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to originate in steipete's plugin text-transform feature work, and the decision is about the long-term public transform boundary rather than a single line fix.
